iterations: Retained model01/02 flat steak/fillet, compressed sack and packet UVs; model03 planar package UVs, rounder steak and flesh, with visibly separated skin slab and potato/dough projection seams; model04 narrows skin to an overlapping strip, restores spherical potato/dough mapping and adds kernel volumes; model05 fills corn gaps with wider overlapping kernels. Exact captures remain evidence of candidate limitations. Model07 reduces and raises the flour fill after oblique inspection found powder protruding through a folded sack wall. Model08 raises the lower salt fill after underside inspection found a small white patch through the wavy packet base. Independent radial/downward containment rays are checked on serialized vertices. Model09 insets the squash flesh on both outer and inner arcs after rear inspection found angular flesh protrusions through the rind. The first cloned validator read the old source family and was corrected before geometry02; geometry02 then found an incorrect corn contact witness, corrected for geometry03. The first visual fixture inherited a wrong F4 condition and rotation limit; corrected before visual02. Explicit native F9/F10 cycle probes were added before visual04. Direct build script launch was denied by the local PowerShell execution policy; a process-scoped Bypass launch built the package. No machine policy was changed.
qualifications: Candidate art: coarse sack weave and regular packet folds, steak/fat edge and visible projection seams, narrow hake skin strip, thick squash rind, regular rounded corn kernels and dough wrap seam/underside swirl require author review.
